deploymentState.deploymentNotes: New callable: creates positions from one uploaded CSV in a single run (replaces one Create Position run per row). Suite 56/56 green on tool, validate+lint clean. Approved by the user in session 2026-09-11.

description: Creates positions from a CSV in ONE run: every row is checked against the title catalog and against only the positions and people the file names, then new positions, their title rows and their holders are written in three bulk calls. An existing position can be renamed, or given a title or holder on a date where it has none; a DIFFERENT title or holder is refused and pointed at the Positions drawer, where that change is dated. Ids are minted from the position code, so the same file uploaded twice changes nothing the second time. dryRun previews.
name: ICM | Bulk Manage Positions
